assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: square original card portrait for the Moss & Ember fantasy strategy game
Primary request: An original portrait for Squall Orb, a spell artifact made of stormglass and copper. Show one unmistakable floating sphere with a contained corkscrew of wind and a few bright cool rain sparks.
Scene/backdrop: Quiet, shallow-focus river workshop with hints of damp slate, dark timber, moss, and soft forge light; keep the background subdued so the orb reads at thumbnail size.
Subject: A single round translucent stormglass orb held by a simple aged-copper collar with a few moss-green patina marks. Inside, a compact pale teal and silver wind spiral curls around tiny blue-white raindrop glints, all visibly contained within the glass. Keep the silhouette centered, bold, and clear with generous safe inset.
Style/medium: Original hand-painted 2.5D game-card illustration, softly sculpted forms, controlled painterly brushwork, matte materials, tactile glass and hammered copper, consistent warm woodland-workshop finish.
Composition/framing: Close square portrait, one central artifact, no crop on the orb or collar, readable shape when reduced to a small card thumbnail.
Lighting/mood: Warm amber forge reflections against restrained cool storm glow; mysterious but calm.
Color palette: Aged copper, moss green, wet slate, deep timber, pale teal, silver, and small amber highlights.
Materials/textures: Smooth stormglass with visible depth, hammered copper collar, delicate moisture beads, soft painted workshop background.
Text (verbatim): None.
Constraints: Keep wind and rain effects contained inside the sphere. No labels, letters, numbers, logos, UI, frame, border, watermark, people, faces, weapons, extra objects, or additional orbs.
Avoid: Fireball or flame-ball appearance, orange fire core, flames, explosion, fiery trail, outward blast, copied commercial game art or characters, recognizable character silhouettes, photorealism, glossy plastic, flat vector art, text.
